reviews.title: Ad Banner??
reviews.text: I loved this app, but the ads are becoming unbearable. I watch the daily ads just about every day in order to get clovers for new themes. I’ve noticed they’ve gotten way longer these past few months and now require me to be interactive with them to finally close out of them and earn my reward. Whatever, I’ve dealt with it because it allows me to collect the themes. But now, the newest addition is that there’s a banner at the bottom of the screen with an ad at all times. Now the ads are even ruining the cutesy look of my monthly themes that I have to sit through ads to buy in the first place. If this continues I may be transitioning to a new day tracking app, which sucks because I’ve been a huge fan and daily user of this app for 2+ years.

reviews.title: Used to be so much better
reviews.text: Used this app for almost 5 years and I loved it but it’s gotten to be way too much. Ads used to be skippable after 5 seconds but now I have to sit through at least 15 seconds, I can’t use things I used to be able to without paying, and I feel like it’s lost a lot of its “simple” feel. I don’t use dailybean anymore and I ended up going back to a paper journal.

reviews.title: Concerning Ads
reviews.text: This app is cute and I was looking forward to using it. But after my first log, I feel a little uneasy. I saw an AI propaganda ad funded by the Israeli Government Advertising Agency. It was through Google, that’s how I was able to check. I’m sure you can understand the multitude of reasons why this is concerning. One, it’s BLATANT propaganda related to an ongoing genocide. Second, what is it doing on a journaling app? I understand that the devs might not have power over the specific ads that get played, but this needs to be addressed somehow. AI propaganda that tries to rationalize the annihilation of innocent people should have no place anywhere, let alone on a cutesy mood tracking app.

reviews.title: Ads are awful
reviews.text:
I had saved my journal entry on the wrong day. I went to edit the day and had to sit through 3 minutes of a monopoly ad that played on a 30 second loop. That’s right - had to watch the same ad 6 times in a row just to change the date on my journal entry. 

Having to watch ads every time you edit an entry is ridiculous. And 3 min is also ridiculous. Looking for a new journal app. I don’t need all the bells and whistles if this is the cost.

reviews.title: Like it but not worth it
reviews.text: I like this app but I thought that by paying for premium I would get access to themes without having to earn or buy clovers. If the themes were free with premium I would keep using it but it’s honestly not worth it, specially because premium is not cheap! Also, I wish I could create calendars to track activity and other things in their own calendars. Overall I like the concept but its not worth it.

reviews.title: Features are locked behind a paywall, no lifetime option
reviews.text: Such a cute app concept! However, I hate that majority of the features are locked behind a paywall with getting new sets since one ad can be equivalent to only one clover and it’s maxed out at 3 ad’s for the “lucky clovers”. I hate monthly and yearly subscriptions and it would be better if the app had a lifetime plan to purchase to keep forever. It would be better without having to constantly pay a subscription. Lifetime plans are better for the users.

reviews.title: Due to the new update I will be deleting.
reviews.text: After this last update I now will be stopping the use of this app in the new year. I used to be able to save my journal and close out of the app in the middle of an ad and it would still save it and I could move on with my day but now if I close out during an ad it won’t save my journal and I’m forced to sit and watch each ad until it’s completely over and finally saves my journal. This is especially annoying because sometimes I forget to add something and used to be able to quickly go back, add it in then close out but now to just add one word it makes you wait to watch the ad all the way through. Because of this I now see the use of this app as more of a nuisance rather than helpful anymore which is really sad because I wrote in it every day this year. Guess I have to find something else to write in for 2026.
